description: tarotene account-wide Renovate automerge policy. Referenced by other repos as github>tarotene/dotfiles//renovate/policy (floating default branch, never tag-pinned — docs/adr/0000-renovate-automerge-shared-preset.md D4).
D1: non-major updates automerge (0.x minor excluded); major and 0.x-minor stay human-merged PRs.
D2: merge executor is GitHub native auto-merge (platformAutomerge); safety depends on the consuming repo's rulesets required_status_checks.
D3: minimumReleaseAge 3 days for everything; vulnerabilityAlerts fixes are exempt (0 days) and automerge.

internalChecksFilter=strict (default, restated for clarity): a version younger than minimumReleaseAge is filtered out entirely, so no PR exists until it ages past the wait — platform auto-merge cannot fire on a pending version.

github-actions.managerFilePatterns has no override (#474): an earlier per-template override narrowed it to workflows only, which silently excluded composite actions (.github/actions/*/action.yml) from digest-pin updates. Renovate's own default already covers both — restated here, not re-narrowed.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: D1: patch/pin/digest automerge for every dependency (0.x included — a patch bump is non-breaking under caret semantics)
D1: minor automerge only from >=1.0.0 (0.x minor may be breaking under caret semantics, so it stays a human-merged PR). v-prefix tolerant for GitHub Action release tags.
GitHub Actions: one grouped PR per run; the group automerges only when every member matches the rules above (a major bump in the group holds the whole group for a human)
